analysis.reasonEn: Recent 5-day -8.13% drop pushed RSI to 43.4, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram continues to worsen from 3.9918 to -1.8225. While the 5-day low ($127.27) is higher than the 20-day low ($100.96) suggesting a potential Higher Low pattern, the 5-day high ($169.83) is not lower than the 20-day high ($169.83), indicating a prevailing Lower High pattern. Weekly RSI is 48.6 and weekly MACD histogram is -4.4852, showing a continued bearish phase. ADX at 16.0 indicates a non-trending period. Current price $128.40 is near the swing resistance of $128.48. Maintaining a sell stance.
